conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Developers address biases in AI by using diverse and representative datasets, implementing fairness metrics, and employing techniques to detect and mitigate biased outcomes. conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Fairness metrics are quantitative measures used to evaluate if an AI system is making equitable decisions across different demographic groups. They help identify and quantify biases within the model's outputs.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For example, a fairness metric might check if a loan approval AI grants loans at similar rates to applicants of different genders or ethnicities.
